verdict.rationale: E2B is designed as an SDK/CLI-driven headless sandbox service — Sandbox.create() runs entirely programmatically via Python/JS SDKs with no UI required, and the CLI supports scripted management of sandboxes and templates, both well-suited for CI pipelines. Self-hosting via Terraform further supports automated infrastructure provisioning. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions integration) or a documented headless-mode flag, and independent confirmation of CI usage beyond docs.
